digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Friday, November 13. Yesterday’s preview shows five planned meeting anchors plus a protected noon work block, while eight items carry forward, seven of them urgent. First, confirm today’s meeting access and time tracking during the continuing Microsoft disruption; then close Amazon Connect’s Angie routing check and Wave 2 readiness for the November 17–18 deployment. Use the afternoon management, executive-status, and IT-pipeline sequence to settle the Product handoff, Operations taskset, and SMS grooming decisions. Outlook Calendar and Email were unavailable after two attempts, so today’s schedule uses Thursday’s published preview and Teams as the live source.

items.label: Close the Amazon Connect rollout follow-through
items.detail: All 12 branch offices are live and AWS raised the user quota to 1,000. Validate Angie’s Dallas call routing, assign the nine Wave 2 virtual-queue Omni flows, classify the 400 added users, and decide whether Wave 3 should move from December 8 to December 1.

items.label: Close the Product handoff and communication gap
items.detail: Set the EPMO intake, initiation, prioritization, and escalation expectations before the new Product process is rolled out, including ownership for IT stories and advance communication of workflow changes.

items.label: Close the Operations readiness decisions
items.detail: Confirm how the taskset blocker affects the RFE or Expansion path, capture the VAWA standalone readiness outcome, and decide whether the November 16 Production Compliance restart can proceed.

items.label: Confirm the SMS grooming and sprint plan
items.detail: Reconcile the Sprint 23 versus Sprint 25 sequence, require a complete user-story inventory by use case, resolve English and Spanish template discrepancies, and confirm Product, IT, architecture, and Marketing roles.

items.label: Review and sign the fake help-desk security alert
items.detail: Rippling is waiting for Jean’s signature on the urgent phishing and fake help-desk notice. Complete the acknowledgment so the security communication can close.

items.label: Complete the overdue EPMO Asana pain-points poll
items.detail: Submit the overdue poll before today’s EPMO management sequence so the team’s current workflow friction is represented.

items.label: Close the remaining meeting and coverage follow-ups
items.detail: Confirm the earlier rollout, Product, portfolio, and leadership overlaps left no unowned action, and identify the IT biweekly occurrence Mar asked to move.

items.label: Confirm the Armando and Amazon Connect coverage outcome
items.detail: Verify yesterday’s 11:30 AM collision was covered, capture any missed follow-up, and close the item if both commitments have clear owners.

items.label: 11:00 AM-noon - Laura 1:1 and Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Confirm meeting access early. Use Laura’s 1:1 to settle the SMS story and template plan, then use the standup for Angie routing and Wave 2 readiness only.

items.label: Noon-1:00 PM - Protected work block
items.detail: Preserve the hour for the highest-risk decision or deliverable from the morning; avoid letting outage troubleshooting consume the full block.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - Management, executive status, and IT pipeline
items.detail: Prepare priority, UAT, intake, and blocker changes before the sequence starts. Calendar timing is based on Thursday’s published preview because live Outlook access is unavailable.

items.label: Confirm today’s meeting access and time tracking
items.detail: Teams reports that Outlook remains unavailable and Toggl meetings are not appearing. Reconfirm links or backup access for today’s anchor meetings, record time manually where needed, and keep decisions in a channel that remains reachable.
